result.analysis_summary: The fixed frontal video shows highly consistent rowing mechanics between the two telemetry-selected intervals. Despite a substantial difference in power output (157 W vs 215 W) and split times, no directly visible differences in recovery duration, hands-away timing, body preparation, seat-handle sequencing, forward reach, stroke length, or stroke-to-stroke rhythm can be observed. The visual evidence does not explain the telemetry discrepancy.

findings.comparison: Interval 3 shows similar recovery duration to Interval 2.
findings.counterevidence: No visible change in recovery speed or posture.
findings.direct_observation: Recovery phase appears smooth and controlled in both intervals.
findings.limitations: Fixed frontal camera angle limits observation of side mechanics.
findings.title: Recovery Duration

findings.comparison: Hands-away timing is similar in both intervals.
findings.counterevidence: No visible difference in timing between strokes.
findings.direct_observation: Hands are away from the handle for a brief period in both intervals.
findings.limitations: Fixed frontal camera angle limits observation of handle movement.
findings.title: Hands-Away Timing

findings.comparison: Body preparation is consistent in both intervals.
findings.counterevidence: No visible change in posture or preparation.
findings.direct_observation: Rower maintains a stable posture with a slight forward lean before the drive.
findings.limitations: Fixed frontal camera angle limits observation of body mechanics.
findings.title: Body Preparation

findings.comparison: Seat-handle sequencing is coordinated in both intervals.
findings.counterevidence: No visible difference in seat or handle movement.
findings.direct_observation: Seat moves smoothly and handle is pulled back in a coordinated manner.
findings.limitations: Fixed frontal camera angle limits observation of seat and handle mechanics.
findings.title: Seat-Handle Sequencing

findings.comparison: Forward reach is consistent in both intervals.
findings.counterevidence: No visible difference in arm extension.
findings.direct_observation: Rower extends arms fully before the drive in both intervals.
findings.limitations: Fixed frontal camera angle limits observation of arm extension.
findings.title: Forward Reach

findings.comparison: Stroke length appears consistent in both intervals.
findings.counterevidence: No visible difference in stroke length.
findings.direct_observation: Stroke length appears consistent with a steady rhythm.
findings.limitations: Fixed frontal camera angle limits observation of stroke length.
findings.title: Stroke Length

findings.comparison: Stroke-to-stroke rhythm is steady in both intervals.
findings.direct_observation: Rhythm is steady with each stroke following the previous one in a predictable pattern.
findings.limitations: Fixed frontal camera angle limits observation of stroke rhythm.
findings.title: Stroke-to-Stroke Rhythm
